Fixes

Fixed default player positions (@Jairo)

More precise seat renovation controls (@Chiadow + @Foni)

Auto-training bug fixed (@Adrian)

Thanks to everyone for your reports, feedback, and support!

notes.title: Early Access v0.0.35-dev Update Released!
notes.content:
🌟 Hello everyone! 🌟

After the launch of the Early Access, it’s been an incredibly intense but truly rewarding day! 🥳 I’d like to thank you all for the support, involvement, and kindness you’ve shown. ❤️

On this first day:
📋 I’ve received over 200 reports, including bugs and suggestions.
⚽ More than 750 matches have been played in total. It’s mind-blowing—thank you so much, I’m truly speechless! 🙌

To keep up this positive momentum, I’ve just released version v0.0.35-dev, which includes:

✨ Suggestions implemented:

📝 @Foni: The top scorers list has been expanded to 20.
🐞 Bugs fixed:

🛠️ @KimRoss: Injured players no longer remain at 0 recovery days without being able to play.
🛠️ @Balaguer: The matchday name now appears in Spanish when the game is set to that language.
🛠️ @Chiadow: The calendar no longer resets to August when reaching December.
🛠️ @Chiadow + @Foni: When making an offer for a player in the transfer market, the club they belong to now displays correctly.
🛠️ @Chiadow: At the start of a new season, previous transfer statuses are no longer carried over to different teams.
Thank you so much again, team! 💪 Let’s keep it up—tomorrow, even better! 🚀

notes.title: Version v.0.0.30-dev released
notes.content:
[center]Hello everyone! 🚀 I’m excited to announce the release of version v0.0.30-dev, which includes the following updates and new features:[/center]

[hr][/hr]

New Features & Updates:
• ⚽ Top Scorers Table: Now available to check the leading scorers.
• 🏆 Steam Achievements: Added the missing achievements.
• 📊 Promotion League Results: Displaying results of ongoing promotion leagues.
• 🐞 Bug Fix: Resolved the issue reported by @kaozz17, where goal stats continued accumulating incorrectly over multiple seasons.
• 📈 Opponent’s Average in Dashboard: View the opposing team’s average performance! (Still working on design placement, but functionality is live.)
• 💪 Player Morale: Morale now fluctuates based on players’ participation in matches, adding a new layer of realism.
• 💥 Splash Screen: A new splash screen on startup for an enhanced experience.
• 👥 Rival Team Rosters: You can view other teams' rosters directly from the standings table.
• 🔄 Transfer System: Initial steps toward player transfers.
• 📮 Feedback Form: A new form in the main menu to share your feedback and suggestions.

[hr][/hr]

What’s Next:
• 🌐 New Website: A website with updated information is in development.
• 🛠️ Database Editor: Advancing the editor to make customization easier.
• 💰 Transfer System: Further improvements to balance the game’s economy.

[hr][/hr]

[center]Thank you all for your support and suggestions! We’re thrilled to keep moving forward together. Looking forward to the next steps! ❤️[/center]

notes.title: Version v.0.0.28-dev released
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

We’re excited to announce a new update for Pro Football! While it’s taken a bit longer than expected, we're back with some great improvements and fixes. Work has been busy, but we're thrilled to be back in action. Below are the details for version v.0.0.28-dev:

New Features:

Database Selection: You can now choose which database to use when starting a new game.
Top Scorer Trophy: A new trophy has been added to recognize the league’s top scorer at the end of the season.
Season Objectives: All leagues are now visible on the screen that displays season objectives.


Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue that caused the training screen to freeze.
Resolved translation errors across various screens.
Fixed the bug that prevented changing the manager’s name when starting a new game.
When hovering over a player in the lineup, they will now be highlighted in the tactics view on the field.


Coming Soon:

In-game bug reporting functionality for easier feedback.
League-specific top scorer tables.
Display of relevant staff members on each screen.
New achievements to unlock.
Player transfer offer system.
A brand new website.


Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more updates!
